summary: Short, steep kerb on a bend with homes 10-13 m away.
reasons: Houses 10-13 m away on same side

best_section.where: Rankin Street west kerb, on the bend before the traffic lights

drivers.seclusion: Homes 10-13 m from the kerb (at 9, 11 and 17 m) on the west side; bush across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Public street; clear kerb lane for a van, though 17 m is short.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street leading to a signalled junction; some through traffic.
drivers.convention: 2P Mon-Fri 9am-5pm sign; cars park on the east side.

flags: Homes within 25 m on the section's own side
sun_shade: Open to the sky; large trees across the road shade the east in the afternoon.
